subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow Anthropic-native `web_search` provider now, and what opt-in, security, billing, and replay policy should gate Anthropic-hosted search?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the feature adds new provider/config surface and changes credential, hosted web access, and transcript/session semantics that automation should not choose by default.

options.title: Design gated provider
options.body: Accept the narrow web-search feature only as an explicit Anthropic-plugin-owned provider with documented security, billing, fallback, and replay behavior before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broad server-tools design
options.body: Defer the narrow provider until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/23353 defines unified policy for Anthropic web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, and server-result handling.

options.title: Decline native hosted search for now
options.body: Keep managed web-search providers as the supported path and document that Anthropic-hosted search is not currently planned.

recommendation.title: Design gated provider
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow web-search feature only as an explicit Anthropic-plugin-owned provider with documented security, billing, fallback, and replay behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest recent history on the Anthropic plugin/provider boundary and the prior visible review context for this cluster.
